data.gender_notes: Sajili is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sajili is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'sajjili' which means 'wisdom', 'learning' or 'knowledge'. It is a name deeply rooted in Hindu culture, representing the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom. The name is also associated with the Hindu goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and learning. The name Sajili carries the meaning “Wisdom, Learning, Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Sajili usually hope their child will grow to embody wisdom, learning, knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
